topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: They said it was for the "best fit," but now I'm stuck here, surrounded by this new bunch, all polished and prim, like they've got it all figured out. I walk in, and it's as if the air thickens, my old spot in the world suddenly vaporized. They give me a tour, all smiles, but it’s clear—they don’t really need me. I’m supposed to blend in, but every step feels forced, like I’m wearing someone else’s shoes. They handed me a new desk, a new computer, and a new set of expectations, as if the old me, the one who knew the rhythm of the old place, never existed.
